claims.claim: A 2020 Management Science study of Estimize found that viewing more public information improved individual earnings forecasts but reduced consensus accuracy, and Estimize switched to a blind platform in November 2015.
claims.episode_span: Individual forecasts got more accurate. The consensus got worse
claims.supporting_quote: Although this improves the accuracy of individual forecasts, it reduces the accuracy of the group consensus forecast because useful private information is prevented from entering the consensus.

claims.claim: A 2017 PNAS paper finds that in decentralized networks social influence can improve the wisdom of crowds.
claims.episode_span: social influence can create learning that improves the group
claims.source_title: Network dynamics of social influence in the wisdom of crowds
claims.supporting_quote: We present theoretical predictions and experimental findings demonstrating that, in decentralized networks, social influence generates learning dynamics that reliably improve the wisdom of crowds.

claims.claim: A 2020 PNAS paper finds that adaptive social networks with plasticity and feedback can produce collective estimates more accurate than the best member.
claims.episode_span: the network can beat its best member
claims.source_title: Adaptive social networks promote the wisdom of crowds
claims.supporting_quote: Our results reveal that, in the presence of plasticity and feedback, social networks can adapt to biased and changing information environments and produce collective estimates that are more accurate than their best-performing member.
